interface.title: IGV-Web (igv-webapp)
interface.stage_of_work: Visual inspection and review of sequencing results (alignments, variant calls, annotations) after primary analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Viewing a reference genome in a browser alongside annotation, read-alignment (BAM/CRAM), variant (VCF) and signal tracks, moving to genes or coordinates, checking reads and genotypes, and saving or sharing the view as a session.

data.note: hg38 and its default RefSeq track streamed from igv.org and UCSC. 1000 Genomes CRAMs (HG00096 from the registry, HG00097 by URL) streamed from public S3. The test files 1kg-variants-session.json and SKBR3-vcf-session.json were loaded through Session > Local File. Some remote hosts could not be reached: the SKBR3 translocation VCFs, the MANE track on ftp.ncbi, and the ENCODE ChIP table (which came up empty). mm10_sample.json did not load as a session or as a genome.
